title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Magadi Road

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office in Magadi Road? SAMAN Portable manufactures ready-to-use container offices and delivers them across this western Bengaluru corridor straight from our factory at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099. We are the manufacturer, not a reseller or listing site, so when you buy a container office for sale in Magadi Road you deal directly with the people who build it, customise it and stand behind it.

Container Offices for Sale in Magadi Road

A container office in Magadi Road is a factory-built, steel-framed office unit that arrives ready to use. SAMAN Portable builds each unit on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, fits insulated wall and roof panels, wiring points, doors and windows, then transports it to your Magadi Road site fully finished. You get a usable workspace in days instead of months, with no on-site civil construction.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard container office footprints. Each can be customised with extra windows, partitions, electrical points, a washroom or air-conditioning provision.

SizeApprox. footprintTypical use
10ftAround 10 x 8 ftSite cabin, security or supervisor office, single desk
20ftAround 20 x 8 ftProject office, 3–4 workstations, small meeting area
40ftAround 40 x 8 ftLarge team office, cabins plus meeting room and washroom

Need a layout that is not listed here? We build to your drawing. Share your floor plan and requirement and we will quote the right configuration.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying factory-direct in Magadi Road means real manufacturer accountability instead of a middleman markup. Here is what you get:

  • MS steel frame to IS 2062 — structural steel built to a recognised Indian standard for strength and durability.
  • Factory-built at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 — units are fabricated and quality-checked in our own unit, not sourced from unknown yards.
  • ISO 9001:2015 — SAMAN POS India Private Limited operates a certified quality management system.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Delivery from ₹3,000 with typical transit of 3–5 days within the Bengaluru region.
  • Returns within 7 days of delivery or installation.

For the full range, sizes and current pricing, see our container office product range.

Delivery and installation in Magadi Road

Magadi Road runs west out of central Bengaluru and connects a long stretch of commercial plots, godowns, industrial sheds and construction sites — exactly the kind of locations a container office suits. Because we manufacture within Bengaluru at Gopasandra (560099), we deliver across the city and along the Magadi Road corridor without relying on long-distance freight.

Each unit leaves our factory finished. On a level, accessible site we craft the placement so the office is ready to switch on quickly. Tell us the access width, ground condition and whether you need the unit on a single level or stacked, and we will plan the lift and set-down before dispatch.

Get a container office quote in Magadi Road

Ready to price your unit? Tell us the size (10ft, 20ft or 40ft), any add-ons such as a washroom, partition or air-conditioning provision, and your Magadi Road delivery address. We will confirm specification, delivery cost and lead time.

Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry on our site to start. For the current range and pricing, browse the container offices range and send your requirement.

FAQs


What sizes of container office do you supply in Magadi Road?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices, and we can build custom layouts to your drawing with partitions, extra windows, a washroom or air-conditioning provision.


How long does delivery to Magadi Road take?

Typical transit is 3–5 days within the Bengaluru region once your unit is ready, since we manufacture locally at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099. Delivery starts from ₹3,000.


Can I customise my container office?

Yes. Every unit can be customised — layout, partitions, electrical points, windows, washroom and air-conditioning provision. Share your floor plan and we will build to it.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Each unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 year figure is engineered service life, not a warranty period.


How is the container office built?

Each unit is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 with insulated wall and roof panels, fabricated and quality-checked at our ISO 9001:2015 certified factory in Bengaluru.


How do I order a container office for Magadi Road?

Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry with your size, add-ons and delivery address. We confirm specification, delivery cost and lead time, then schedule build and dispatch.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
